title: Dutch Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with lamb and a blend of spices.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the Worcestershire sauce, Dutch mustard, and smoked paprika to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Return the lamb to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
